note: The sector plan for 2026-2029, read whole, names no system in which a police station records a report or a case, and says nothing of how stations record. It sets 100% digitalisation of the sector's services by 2029 as an objective and costs sector-wide projects to digitise all security agency databases and to map stations and posts, and it cites inadequate ICT infrastructure and logistics shortfalls in rural and border communities as constraints; none of this is tied to a record-class system, so there is no fact. The Ghana Police Service is made responsible for reporting crime data, with no system named.
